pages.title: Start With Scorch
pages.text: Open mastery:scorch in Definitions > Keywords. Its periodic lane applies fire damage over time; its threshold lane creates the burst. Change duration, maximum stacks, and threshold to fit your pack.

pages.title: Author the Damage
pages.text: Add damage to Periodic actions. Set school to irons_spellbooks:fire, amount to your per-stack damage, and per_stack true. Set tick_interval to 20 for once per second. Add flame particles if desired.

pages.title: Author the Burst
pages.text: Switch to Threshold actions. Add damage with target nearby, center target, and your radius. Add explosion particles targeting target. Enable consume_stacks to spend the accumulated scorch. This burst is scripted damage, so it does not break terrain.

pages.title: Connect a Skill
pages.text: Create a hit trigger with a keyword action targeting target and choosing mastery:scorch. Adjust its chance. Save the keyword before a trigger that references it, then save the node with a mastery:trigger effect. Existing bundled IDs already resolve.
